messages:
ana: Heads-up 1! Product wants to ship a new "Commercial Composer" offering. Core asks: priority-lane add-on, reserved throughput-pack with burst credits, and per-route caps. Need consensus on launch criteria + contract language. 30m sync at 3?

liz: 3pm works. Quick Q: what measurable SLOs should we promise for priority lane? p50/p95?

sam: Recommend p50 <= 30ms, p95 <= 120ms for interactive composer prompts on priority lane. Must include explicit fallback to standard tier and failure modes.

mohit: Implementation options: 1) soft-priority via router weights (low infra cost) or 2) dedicated pools (higher cost, strict isolation). Pilot: soft-priority. Dedicated pools reserved for Composer Pro. Rough infra delta: +20% for soft; +120% for dedicated.

ralph: Pricing pilot thought: discounted pilot (25% off) with small commit to gather billing signals. Need mapping from commit to discount table for sales.

legal: Will draft two templates: Pilot Addendum (timeboxed, limited liability) and Enterprise SLA (credits, termination). Avoid words like 'guaranteed' unless SLOs and credits are explicit.

ana: @ops-bot please attach last quarter top routes + burst CSV so we can size burst credits.

ops-bot: Export ready: https://internal.redwood/exports/top-routes-q4.csv (uploaded) :file_folder:

liz: Add quality requirement: no >5% regression on composer eval set if we use quantized models or smaller variants.

sam: Proposed launch criteria: Tech pilot w/ 3 customers (2 workload classes) for 4 weeks, pricing + legal approved, ops rollback tested, quality guardrail met.

mohit: Instrumentation must be in place before GA: per-tenant token billing traces, latency heatmaps, per-route throttle counters.

ralph: Packaging SKUs suggestion: Composer Lite (soft-priority + small reserved), Composer (priority lane + medium reserved), Composer Pro (dedicated pools + enterprise SLA). Map discounts to commit tiers.

legal: Also flag export-control and indemnity for regulated customers in pilot.

ana: Action items:
- ana: book 30m sync at 3pm
- liz: propose eval prompt set by EOD
- sam: draft pricing uplift table tomorrow
- mohit: infra estimate + blockers in 24h
- legal: pilot addendum draft in 48h
- ops-bot: attach perf traces and CSV to thread

sam: Wording proposal for docs: "Priority lane: routing priority with documented SLO and documented fallback behavior." Keeps expectations tight.

liz: +1. Add 'best-effort during model rollouts' note.

mohit: Router snippet we tested (for RFC): ```yaml
route_priority: soft
weights:
  composer: 1.5
  standard: 1.0
burst_window_seconds: 600
max_burst_tokens: 200000
``` Put in RFC.

ana: If dedicated pools block timeline, GA will be soft-priority; reserve dedicated for Pro. Pilot: discounted with 3-month min commit. Ralph ok?

ralph: Yes 25% off for pilot, 3mo min, option to convert to commit.

ops-bot: Export attached: https://internal.redwood/exports/top-routes-q4.csv

ana: Post-sync notes + RFC link: https://internal.redwood/rfcs/commercial-composer-draft. Next sync in T+3 days to review pilot contract drafts and eval prompt proposals.
